g.text: 146.2 × 143.2 mm · top view · ports from the NI dimension drawing

circle.title: USB Device (USB-B, to a laptop for setup and imaging)
USB Host, upper (USB 2.0 Type-A, 900 mA), e.g. CANivore
USB Host, lower (USB 2.0 Type-A, 900 mA)
Ethernet 10/100 RJ45 (to the radio)
INPUT V (+, red) / C (−, black), 7–16 V, 18 AWG from a PDH 10 A fused channel
CAN L (GRN) / H (YEL), push-button terminal; 120 Ω terminator built in
I2C (GND, 3.3V, SCL, SDA), 4-pin 0.1 in header
RS-232 (GND, RXD, TXD), 3-pin 0.1 in header
SPI 2x5 header (CS0-CS3, SCLK, COPI, CIPO, 3.3V, 5V, GND)
DIO 0 (S / 5V / GND, 3.3 V logic, 5 V tolerant)
PWM 0 (S / 6V servo power / GND, 5 V signal)

PWM 1 (S / 6V servo power / GND, 5 V signal)
DIO 2 (S / 5V / GND, 3.3 V logic, 5 V tolerant)

PWM 3 (S / 6V servo power / GND, 5 V signal)
DIO 4 (S / 5V / GND, 3.3 V logic, 5 V tolerant)
PWM 4 (S / 6V servo power / GND, 5 V signal)

PWM 5 (S / 6V servo power / GND, 5 V signal)

DIO 9 (S / 5V / GND, 3.3 V logic, 5 V tolerant)
PWM 9 (S / 6V servo power / GND, 5 V signal)
MXP 34-pin expansion port (16 DIO, 4 AI, 2 AO, UART, I2C, SPI, 3.3V, 5V)
RSL port (S = switched VIN, 120 mA max / GND outer pin) to the robot signal light
Relay 0 (FWD / REV / GND, 5 V outputs)
Analog in 0 (S / 5V / GND, 0-5 V)
